system.history:
A skilled tradesperson familiar with heavy equipment, work sites, structural hazards, and practical problem solving.

Scene use: Hazard witness, equipment operator, rescue helper, site guide, or civilian who notices when a structure is about to fail.
system.personality: Practical, direct, and protective of coworkers. Responds well to clear plans and visible competence.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Hard hat, high-visibility clothing, work gloves, tool belt, and protective footwear.

system.description: A sturdy hand tool used as an improvised close weapon.
